title: 2009 Prairie's chimneys in red-brown brick, and its two young street trees
items: The Mayer-Meyer house's tall chimneys and side walls are now the same dark red-brown brick as its front, as its old photograph shows them, not a pale buff.
The two slender young elms the photograph shows on the grass strip in front of the house now stand there, one by its north corner and one south of its steps, replacing a single full-grown elm.
